H1_EXISTING_EVIDENCE.description: Human used evidence Machine already had

H2_NEW_OBSERVATION.description: Human accessed document for missing observation

H4_SEMANTIC_BOUNDARY.description: Human uncertain even with complete evidence (G5)

Type_A.description: Machine evidence sufficient; Human judges quickly

Type_B.description: Pack incomplete; system has info but not exposed

Type_D.description: Even with document, Human can't judge

minimum_feedback_scheme.provenance: YES (judgment linked to Evidence Pack element)
minimum_feedback_scheme.rationale: Evidence configuration (F1-F12 active) IS the explanation; no text needed

E_judgment_plus_freetext.verdict: NOT RECOMMENDED (turns Human into Annotation Worker)

binding_chain.valid: Human Judgment → Evidence Reference → Evidence Configuration → Validated Evidence Instance
binding_chain.provenance_without_text: Judgment + Evidence ID + Evidence Configuration = sufficient provenance for ALL 79 cases

five_level_hierarchy.Level_1_CASE_SPECIFIC: One judgment, no generalization (14 UNCERTAIN cases stuck here)
five_level_hierarchy.Level_2_EVIDENCE_LINKED: Judgment + Evidence ID + Config (65 definitive cases reach this with Scheme B)
five_level_hierarchy.Level_3_REPEATED_PATTERN: ≥2 cases with same config + same judgment (POTENTIAL: caption_like 39 YES, Type_A_neg 8 NO)
five_level_hierarchy.critical_rule: Single case CANNOT skip levels. H4_SEMANTIC_BOUNDARY cannot become reusable (no judgment to repeat).

reusable_signal_conditions: Cross-case consistency (same judgment for same config)
Provenance (Judgment + Evidence ID for each instance)

three_boundaries.Boundary_A_EVIDENCE: Machine observable/organizable facts (F1-F12, P1-P7, DGF/DEF, Evidence Pack)
three_boundaries.Boundary_B_HUMAN_VALIDATION: Human judgment on specific case (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN + Evidence ID)
three_boundaries.Boundary_C_REUSABLE_SIGNAL: Multiple validated cases with repeated pattern (requires accumulation)
three_boundaries.rule: B ≠ C; Single Human Judgment ≠ Reusable Signal; Human Validation ≠ Capability

extra_information_recording.recommended: Option B: Document Access Log (page/region viewed)

limitations.limitation: SINGLE HUMAN REVIEWER — no inter-rater reliability
limitations.impact: Binding scheme validity unverified across reviewers

limitations.limitation: SINGLE TASK (Text-Drawing only) — T2/T3 not tested
NO IMPLEMENTATION TEST — design proposal only
EVIDENCE CONFIG SIMILARITY NOT VERIFIED — Level 3 not confirmed
REUSABLE SIGNAL NOT DEMONSTRATED — cross-document not analyzed
P1 INCONCLUSIVE — no Human-level benefit demonstrated
limitations.impact: Cannot claim Scheme B improves performance

limitations.limitation: NO G5 BINDING — 14 UNCERTAIN cases cannot be bound
limitations.impact: Scheme B works for definitive, not boundary cases

final_questions.Q1_minimum_info_unit: Scheme B: YES/NO/UNCERTAIN + Evidence ID (2 fields, LOW burden)
final_questions.Q2_free_text_required: NO — provenance via Evidence ID + Configuration, not text
final_questions.Q4_how_much_is_existing_evidence: 77.2% (61/79) — Human added NO new evidence; used existing or confirmed
final_questions.Q5_how_much_genuinely_new: 5.1% (4/79) — new observation from document; 0% external knowledge
final_questions.Q6_case_specific_only: 14 UNCERTAIN (G5 boundary) + 4 new observation = 18 cases cannot generalize
final_questions.Q7_reusable_signal_capable: 61 definitive cases with complete evidence; 21 H1 + potential 40 H4_CONFIRMATION patterns
final_questions.Q8_reusable_signal_minimum_conditions: ≥2 cases + ≥2 documents + same config + same judgment + provenance + boundary
final_questions.Q9_evidence_semantic_boundary: At L2→L3 transition: Structural Claim (Evidence) ← → Semantic Identity (Human Judgment)
final_questions.Q10_next_phase_design_gate: CONDITIONAL — needs config similarity verification + multi-reviewer test (requires Human Validation authorization)
